provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized bicycle at m=233, with ord_2(m)=29, so x^233 - 1 factors over GF(2) into 9 cyclotomic cosets, 1 of size 1, 8 of size 29. The divisor g is assembled from coset minimal polynomials to degree 30, which fixes k = 2 deg g = 60 by construction, and (a,b) was drawn from the ideal (g) by information-set decoding over sparse supports, keeping weight 8 and weight 8 in the two blocks. Both weights are even, so x+1 divides the gcd; x+1 is x^1 - 1, so the only block logical this forces has weight m and is far above the claim. m is prime, so the quotient fold has no proper divisor to act on; an orbit fold over every equal-orbit partition of the qubits returns nothing lighter than 176. H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)] and H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T] on n = 2m = 466 qubits at uniform row weight 16, with a = [13, 22, 32, 39, 108, 144, 155, 177] and b = [14, 37, 129, 155, 167, 194, 203, 224].
